description:
The monster swallows a [[lookup @target.affects.special activity=IPD9mDjKJEXc2uMQ]] target it is grappling. While swallowed, the target isn't Grappled but has the &Reference[Blinded apply=false] and &Reference[Restrained apply=false] conditions, and it has &Reference[Total Cover] against attacks and other effects outside the frog.

While swallowing the target, the monster can't use Bite, and if the monster dies, the swallowed target is no longer Restrained and can escape from the corpse using 5 feet of movement, exiting with the &Reference[Prone apply=false] condition.

At the end of the monster's next turn, the swallowed target takes [[/damage 2d4 acid average]] damage. If that damage doesn't kill it, the monster disgorges it, causing it to exit &Reference[Prone apply=false].
name: Swallow
